biography: Alexander Rossi, a name synonymous with audacious overtakes and unapologetic flair, hails from the bustling streets of Los Angeles, California. His racing journey began not in the sanitized world of karting academies, but in the gritty, unsanctioned street races of his youth. He recounts a pivotal night where, at just 16, he outmaneuvered a seasoned veteran in a modified Honda Civic, a victory that solidified his burning desire to race professionally. Rossi honed his skills in various open-wheel series, demonstrating a remarkable ability to adapt to different machinery and track conditions. After a brief stint in European racing that didn't quite pan out as expected, Rossi returned to the States, where he found his niche in domestic racing, showcasing his talent in series like F-USA. Now in his prime, Rossi continues to push the boundaries of speed and style, leaving his mark on every track he graces.
drivingStyle: Rossi's driving style is a high-octane blend of aggression and precision. He's known for his late-braking maneuvers and willingness to divebomb into corners, often leaving rivals scrambling for space. Tire management isn't always his strong suit, as he tends to favor pushing the car to its absolute limit early in a stint. Under pressure, Rossi either thrives or implodes spectacularly; there's rarely an in-between. His aggressive style makes him a thrilling driver to watch, but also prone to costly mistakes.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry stemming from a controversial collision during the 2021 F-USA championship decider. Rossi maintains Vieri intentionally wrecked him.

quirks: Always wears a lucky pair of socks with a checkered flag pattern.
Listens to a specific heavy metal song (Pantera's "Walk") precisely 15 minutes before every race.
Refuses to use the number '13' on any of his cars, citing an old family superstition.
famousQuote: "Second place is just the first loser. You race to win, or you don't race at all."
careerHighlight: Winning the 2022 F-USA race at Laguna Seca with a daring last-lap overtake, cementing his reputation as a fearless racer.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final race of the 2021 F-USA season due to contact with Marco Vieri, losing the championship by a single point.
